description.value: The Copper Coil Still & Grill is a locally owned, family-operated restaurant in Squamish that fuses Cajun and Louisiana cooking traditions with Pacific Northwest seasonal and regional ingredients. Hand-crafted BBQ dishes anchor a menu designed around fresh, local produce in the spirit of New Orleans cuisine. Squamish is a major hub on the Sea to Sky cycling corridor, and the restaurant sits on Cleveland Avenue near the town centre.
